title: Spain World Cup Champions Merch Drops Online: Shop Official T-Shirts, Hoodies and Jerseys Here
summary: Sunday's victory over Argentina marked the second World Cup win for Spain, who also took home the trophy in 2010.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Viva España! Spain has won the 2026 FIFA World Cup , with the Spanish men’s national soccer team taking down Argentina by a score of 2-1 in Sunday’s tournament finale .

Ferran Torres scored the winning goal for Spain in extra time, in a World Cup final that also saw Justin Bieber, BTS, Madonna, Shakira, Coldplay and others perform during the halftime show .

Now, fans can celebrate the team’s win with official Spain World Cup winners merch online. The apparel and collectibles site Fanatics, has official Team Spain World Cup champions T-shirts, hoodies and jerseys available to buy right now.

As a description teases, “The Spain National Team stands atop the soccer world after outlasting the best of the best on the sport’s biggest stage. Wear the moment, relive the glory, and celebrate a team that gave everything to become champions.”

JUST RELEASED

Spain National Team 1863FC 2026 Champions Legacy T-Shirt

$38

Buy Now AT FANATICS

This unisex T-shirt celebrates La Roja and their big World Cup win with the team crest on the front and a streetwear-style graphic on the back.

The 100% cotton tee is available in sizes small to 2XL. This is an officially-licensed T-shirt from the merch and apparel brand 1863FC, named after the year the first ever Football Association originated.

OFFICIAL TEAM COLORS

Spain National Team 1863FC 2026 Champions T-Shirt

You can also pick up this T-shirt in the official Spanish national team colors of yellow and red.

The T-shirt features a simple logo on the front and the year 2026 in bold on the back along with the words Selección de fútbol de España — a.k.a. the Spanish national football team.

OFFICIAL HOODIE

Spain National Team adidas 2026 FIFA World Cup Champions Trophy Hoodie

$65

Celebrate the Spanish champions — or campeónes — with this official World Cup winners hoodie.

The unisex hoodie features a crest with the FIFA World Cup trophy in gold on the front and the word ESPANA and the number 26 (for the year 2026) on the back. Choose from sizes small to 3XL.

ACT FAST

Spain National Team Adidas 2026 FIFA World Cup Champions Replica Jersey

$100

You can pick up this official Spain World Cup jersey on the Fanatics website, now with the addition of a 2026 World Cup Champions patch.

This is an official Adidas replica soccer jersey, inspired by the same kits worn by the team on the pitch. The jersey is made from the brand’s “Climacool” sweat-wicking material, with the Adidas logo on the front and three stripes along the shoulder. This item is available in sizes XS to 2XL and is expected to sell quickly so we recommend adding to cart while your size is still in stock online.

You can see more officially licensed Spain World Cup champions merch — including Lamine Yamal jerseys — online at Fanatics.com .

ALSO AVAILABLE

World Cup 2026 Spain T-Shirt

$16.99

Buy Now On Amazon

And you can pick up this T-shirt on Amazon, available in ten different colors and in multiple sizes for men and women.

This Spain World Cup winners shirt features the phrase por la victoria — for the win.

Sunday’s victory marked the second World Cup win for Spain, who also took home the trophy in 2010.
